messages:
maria: Heads-up: opening a docs PR to migrate the 'latency heatmap' dashboard widget and update tracehook Go+Python snippets to use the new trace_key param. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422. Can folks review the examples and confirm QoS numbers? cc @ajay @sam
ajay: Quick skim: heatmap YAML needs rename 'bucket_ranges' -> 'latency_buckets' (new metrics API). Also the Go snippet still uses old ctx key; I'll paste fix.
sam: On it. Will verify dashboard YAML against staging console. Also we should add a short note about cost/latency tradeoff for sampling rates.
elaine: Thanks — one more: examples refer to 'trace_id' header; change to 'x-rw-trace'. I can do small patch.
maria: Great. Also wondering if we should include an example of prefix caching impact. Maybe a small table showing tokens vs cost.
sam: Yes: propose a single-row table in markdown. Or we can add an inline code block showing curl: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/generate
ajay: Here's the Go snippet fix: ```go
ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, rwtrace.Key, rwtrace.FromHTTP(req))
client.Generate(ctx, ...)
``` Replace WithValue usage with rwtrace.NewContext(req).
docs-bot: lint/preview: preview site build started for PR #1422.
maria: PR updated with Go+py patches. I added a short 'rollout notes' section: 'If you rely on per-token cost breakdown, update pipeline to emit trace.sample_rate metadata.'
elaine: One last nit: broken link to 'kv-cache best practices' in migration guide. I'll open a tiny PR to fix link and add redirect.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll run a local smoke test of the dashboard after the linkfix. If green, we can merge.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: staging docs site passed smoke tests for PR #1422.
maria: Awesome — merging after one more review from @ajay. Thanks all :rocket:
